title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 5: the covenant at Horeb, the ten commandments and the people's fear of the fire.

questions.text: With whom does Moses say Yahweh made the covenant at Horeb?
questions.explanation: Moses says Yahweh did not make this covenant with their fathers, but with "us, who are all of us here alive today."

answers.text: Only with their fathers
Only with the priests and the elders
With those who were all there alive that day
With all the nations around Israel

questions.text: Why did the people not go up onto the mountain?
questions.explanation: Moses stood between Yahweh and the people to show them Yahweh's word, because they were afraid of the fire and did not go up onto the mountain.

answers.text: They were afraid because of the fire
The elders had forbidden it
They were too tired from the journey
It was the Sabbath day

questions.text: To whom does Yahweh show loving kindness, according to Deuteronomy 5:10?
questions.explanation: Yahweh shows loving kindness to thousands of those who love him and keep his commandments.

answers.text: Only the sons of Levi who serve at his altar
All who bring him burnt offerings and sacrifices
Only those among them who have never sinned
Thousands of those who love him and keep his commandments

questions.text: How many days does the commandment say they shall labor and do all their work?
questions.explanation: The commandment says: "You shall labor six days, and do all your work"; the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh.

answers.text: Five
Six
Seven
Four

questions.text: What reason for keeping the Sabbath does Deuteronomy 5:15 give?
questions.explanation: They were to remember that they were servants in the land of Egypt and that Yahweh brought them out; therefore he commanded them to keep the Sabbath.

answers.text: They were servants in Egypt and Yahweh brought them out
Manna fell on only six days of the week
Moses came down from the mountain on that day
The walls of a city fell on the seventh day

questions.text: What promise is attached to honoring father and mother?
questions.explanation: They are to honor father and mother so that their days may be long and it may go well with them in the land Yahweh gives them.

answers.text: That they will become rich in silver and gold
That their own children will honor them in turn
Long days, and that it may go well with them in the land
That they will have many sons and daughters

questions.text: Which of these is listed in Deuteronomy 5:21 among the things of the neighbor that they shall not desire?
questions.explanation: They shall not desire their neighbor's house, field, male or female servant, ox, donkey, or anything that is their neighbor's.

answers.text: His silver
His field
His vineyard
His sword

questions.text: What did Yahweh do with these words after speaking them to the assembly?
questions.explanation: Yahweh spoke these words out of the fire, added no more, wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to Moses.

answers.text: He wrote them on a scroll and gave it to Aaron
He carved them into the stones of the altar
He had the elders write them down for the people
He wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to Moses

questions.text: Why did the heads of the tribes and the elders ask Moses to go near instead of them?
questions.explanation: They said this great fire would consume them, and if they heard Yahweh's voice any more they would die.

answers.text: They wanted to return to Egypt
They thought Moses was the oldest among them
They feared the great fire would consume them
They were busy keeping the Sabbath

questions.text: What were the people told to do while Moses stayed with Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses: "Go tell them, 'Return to your tents.'" Moses was to stand by Yahweh to hear all the commandments.

answers.text: Return to their tents
Wait at the foot of the mountain
Build an altar of stones
Fast for forty days
